reason: Resolve Chaos Warp's actual unique coverage versus already-present Otawara channel, creature removal and stack counters, and avoid loss of source-verified inexpensive Warhammer commander identity cards.

role_fixed_oracle.oracle: The owner of target permanent shuffles it into their library, then reveals the top card of their library. If it's a permanent card, they put it onto the battlefield.

role_fixed_oracle.channel: {3}{U}, Discard this card: Return target artifact, creature, enchantment, or planeswalker to its owner's hand. This ability costs {1} less for each legendary creature you control.

role_fixed_oracle.oracle: Whenever a land you control enters from anywhere other than your hand or you cast a spell from anywhere other than your hand, create a 3/3 red Spawn creature token.

bounded_rules_cases: Rule of Law and Arcane Laboratory resolved: opponent-end-step instant spell answer versus zero-spell channel alternative; no second hand spell while effect remains
Rule of Law: already cast one spell this turn prevents Chaos Warp cast, but does NOT prevent Otawara's channel activation; channel available only from hand
Chaos Warp targeting Rule of Law while Abaddon cascade threshold active cannot cast the cascade hit during the trigger under restriction; Warp resolves after the cascade trigger
Chaos Warp may put new permanent (even original restraining permanent) on battlefield, so resolution has randomized unknown substitute, not guaranteed permanent removal
Otawara bounces but opponent can replay stax; distinction of repeatability and recurrence from shuffled original
Rest in Peace graveyard fuel previously exiled is not restored by removing Rest in Peace
Drannith Magistrate creature: existing Deadly Rollick handles resolved Magistrate; different from enchantment / colorless artifact
Swan Song and Force of Negation can intercept some spells on stack, cannot answer already-resolved enchantments as counterspells
Pyroblast cannot effectively destroy white enchantments/colorless artifacts; situational blue protection stays relevant
